newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Tabcorp hits record high on result.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Tabcorp hits record high on result.

text.p: Shares in Tabcorp Holdings Ltd hit a record high on Monday after the betting agency reported a strong lift in its annual results for the year to June 30, 1996.
At 10.40 a.m. (0040 GMT), Tabcorp shares were 16 cents or 2.77 percent up at A$5.93 with 271,031 shares traded.
The Melbourne-based group listed in August 1994.
Tabcorp surprised the sharemarket with a special dividend of 12 cents a share for the second half on top of 10 cents a share final dividend, making a total of 31 cents a share for the year.
"I think Tabcorp is sending a clear message to the market that it is going to pay out excess cash to shareholders and not keep it in the balance sheet," one Melbourne-based broker said.
The broker said there was all sorts of rumours that Tabcorp was going to make an acquisition.
"I think the market would prefer to see a capital return to shareholders, then Tabcorp going out a spending the money," he said. -- Sydney newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
